{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter for converted customers only
converted_customers = data[data['converted'] == 1]

# Exclude rows where customer_age is -1 (missing data sentinel)
valid_age_customers = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = valid_age_customers['customer_age'].mean()

# Print result
print(f"Mean age of converted customers (excluding age == -1): {mean_age}")"}
